title: Salvia officinalis essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Salvia officinalis essential oil is derived from the leaves of the common sage plant through steam distillation. It is widely used in herbalism for its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and cognitive-enhancing properties. This essential oil is often applied topically to treat skin infections, wounds, and respiratory conditions. It can also be used in aromatherapy to support mental clarity and reduce stress. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its ability to promote digestion and soothe sore throats.
